main.description: Add an MCP server to the org. Nobody signs in to it yet: for an oauth server pear discovers its authorization server and registers itself as a client, by dynamic client registration unless clientId is given, and each member then connects with startAuthorization; a manual server needs no auth, so every member is connected to it automatically. Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community to add the server to.

name.description: Also becomes the server's ID and the namespace under which its tools are exposed. Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only, and must be unique within the org.

authType.description: How pear authenticates to the server; see network.habitat.mcp.defs#server.

clientId.description: oauth servers only: the ID of an OAuth client pre-registered with the server's authorization server, for servers that don't support dynamic client registration. Its redirect URI must be pear's MCP OAuth callback.

clientSecret.description: oauth servers only: the pre-registered client's secret, if it has one. Stored encrypted and never returned.
